turns.content: Write the standard temperature dependence of a type-I superconductor's critical magnetic field H_c(T) in terms of H_c(0), T, and T_c.
Record the supplied lead parameters: T_c=7.19 K, H_c(0)=63.9 kA/m, and applied field H=20 kA/m.
At the relevant boundary, equate the applied field and the temperature-dependent field, then write the equation for the unknown boundary value.
Rearrange the transition equation to isolate the squared reduced pressure term.
Solve symbolically for the requested boundary value.
Check how the solved boundary value changes as the applied field increases within this model.
Evaluate and report the temperature at which lead becomes ferromagnetic in the applied field.
